class.name: CSVReader
class.brief_description: Reads a large CSV file row by row.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the file. The reader is at its end afterwards; reading and [method seek_row] fail with an error. The file is also closed when the last reference to the reader goes away.

method.name: count_rows
method.description: Returns the number of data rows (without the header row). The first call reads on to the end of the file and returns to the current row; later calls return the stored number. Returns [code]-1[/code] if the file has an invalid row (see [method get_error]) or the reader is closed.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns [constant OK], or the error of the invalid row that stopped the reader ([constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR]). See [method get_error_message].

method.name: get_error_line
method.description: Returns the 1-based line of the error, or [code]0[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the message of the error, for example [code]Line 7: the quoted cell is not closed.[/code], or an empty string if there is none.

method.name: get_header
method.description: Returns the column names of the header row, or an empty array if [member SerializerOptions.csv_headers] is off or the file is empty.

method.name: get_line
method.description: Returns the 1-based line of the next row. A quoted cell with line breaks makes it larger than the row number.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the path the reader was opened with.

method.name: get_row_index
method.description: Returns the index (from [code]0[/code], without the header row) of the row that the next [method read_row] returns.

method.name: is_eof
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once a read has found no more rows (or the reader is closed). It stays [code]false[/code] after the last row has been read, until the next read; test the result of [method read_row] for an empty array.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens the file at [param path] and reads the header row (with [member SerializerOptions.csv_headers]). [param options] [code]null[/code] uses the project settings. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the file cannot be opened, the header row is invalid (a quoted cell that is not closed) or the delimiter is not an ASCII character.

method.name: read_record
method.description: Reads the next row as a [Dictionary] keyed by the column names of [method get_header]; cells missing at the end of a short row are empty strings. Returns an empty [Dictionary] at the end of the file or on an error, and prints an error if there is no header.

method.name: read_row
method.description: Reads the next row. Returns an empty array at the end of the file or on an error (a row always has at least one cell).

method.name: read_rows
method.description: Reads up to [param count] rows as an [Array] of [PackedStringArray]. The rows are all in memory at once: read large files in pages with a bounded [param count]. Fewer are returned at the end of the file or on an error.

method.name: seek_row
method.description: Moves to the data row [param row] (from [code]0[/code]; [method read_row] then returns it; [param row] equal to the number of rows is the end of the file and returns [constant OK]) and clears the error. Returns [constant ERR_FILE_EOF] if the file has fewer rows than [param row] (the reader is at the end), [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] if a row before it is invalid, and [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if the reader is closed. Moving back, or forward within 1024 rows, is cheap once the reader has passed the row; a first jump far ahead reads every row on the way (without building them).

method.name: skip_rows
method.description: Skips [param count] rows without building their cells. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_FILE_EOF] if the file ends first, or [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR].
